text:
nina: Heads-up 1: dropping the marketplace quickstart IaC validation harness into the partner repo. Purpose: let cloud partners run a reproducible terraform test that verifies module inputs, outputs, and a small demo deploy.
samir: Nice. Is this the same harness we prototyped for the GCP/OCI template or a new one?
nina: New, smaller. Single terraform module + a smoke app (nginx) to validate networking, loadbalancer, and KMS integration. Should be runnable in ~30-45m.
lucy: What are the acceptance checks the harness performs?
nina: Current checks:
- terraform fmt & validate
- static module lint (tflint + custom rules)
- terraform init && plan (no apply in CI)
- optional local apply for partner manual runs (script: scripts/run_local_demo.sh)
- smoke test: curl LB endpoint -> 200
- artifacts: manifest.yaml and module-compat.json

rory: Can you paste the example varfile? Partners often get tripped by region/AZ defaults.
nina: Sure:
```
# partners.tfvars
region = "us-east-1"
availability_zones = ["us-east-1a","us-east-1b"]
instance_profile = "partner-demo-role"
kms_key_id = "arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:123456:key/abcd"
```
samir: We should include a mapping table for instance_type vs expected perf tiers (cpu/quantized/gpu). sales always asks.
lucy: I'll add that to docs. Also adding a short troubleshooting section for the usual LB SG / healthcheck issues.
ci-bot: CI: running module-lint pipeline for branch nina/marketplace-harness -> status: queued
nina: The harness lives under examples/marketplace-quickstart/ with two entrypoints: `validate_module.sh` and `run_local_demo.sh`.
marketplace-bot: package marketplace-quickstart v0.3 created at s3://marketplace-artifacts/2181112222/marketplace-quickstart-v0.3.tar.gz
rory: For partners wanting to skip KMS they can set `kms_disabled = true` (we included that toggle) but note we mark the module as "KMS recommended" in manifest.
samir: Can we add a tiny perf-check that measures p95 of 100 requests? Not full benchmark, just sanity.
nina: added `bench/simple_lat.py` (requests, 100x) and a small README section on interpreting results.
lucy: QA asks that we include a compatibility matrix: terraform version, provider versions, supported regions. I'll draft.
nina: Follow-ups:
- nina: add perf-check README + sample output (ETA today)
- lucy: compatibility matrix + infra mapping table (ETA EOD)
- samir: add instance_type perf mapping for sales (ETA tomorrow)
- rory: schedule partner dry-run with 1 SI (next Tue)

samir: One more ask: include a short checklist for marketplace packaging (manifest fields we care about: name, version, provider_requirements, supported_arch).
nina: Good call. I'll include `package_checklist.md` and a tiny validator `scripts/validate_manifest.py`.
ci-bot: CI: module-lint pipeline started -> status: success
marketplace-bot: notarization scan passed for marketplace-quickstart v0.3
rory: Once CI passes can we create a partner preview link and a one-page quickstart? Partners want something they can forward to their infra team.
nina: Will do. Creating preview and short email template after tag v0.3 -> v1.0 when we get partner signoff.
lucy: Moving to merge queue. If anyone hits provider errors ping me directly.
nina: Thanks team. Uploads + PR link incoming. :white_check_mark:
